title: What It Actually Looks Like to Love Your Enemy and Still Hold the Line
caption:
Jesus said love your enemies. He never said hand them your keys.

Love is what you want for him. Trust is what he earns. A godly man can hold both without turning cold or turning into a doormat.

Send this to someone who's tired of being walked on.

#faith #forgiveness #boundaries #godlyman
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
